title: Mintu Ka Homework Ninja Trick!
visual_style: Bright, colorful 2D cartoon animation with expressive, funny facial expressions and fast-paced comic sound effects in a consistent original cartoon universe

characters.name: Mintu
characters.appearance: 9-year-old naughty boy with messy black hair tied in a small ponytail, wheatish skin tone, expressive round eyes
characters.clothing: Bright red T-shirt with a blue star graphic and blue denim shorts
characters.personality: Naughty, clever, mischievous, always trying to dodge homework

characters.name: Mummy
characters.appearance: Super observant Indian mother with black hair tied in a neat bun, warm wheatish skin tone, sharp and knowing eyes
characters.clothing: Teal green cotton saree with a yellow border
characters.personality: Strict, loving, zero tolerance for homework dodging, smart

scenes.narration: Wait... ye Mintu sofa ke peeche kyun chup raha hai? Kuch toh gadbad hai yaar!
scenes.dialogue: Guys, mission 'Homework Escape' is ON! Mummy ko lag raha hai main padh raha hoon.
scenes.action: Mintu slowly crawling behind the sofa, hiding a heavy math notebook.
scenes.background: Cozy Indian living room with a colourful sofa and a patterned rug.
scenes.camera: Low angle, medium close-up shot tracking Mintu's movement.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu, a 9-year-old naughty boy with a messy black ponytail, wearing a bright red T-shirt with a blue star and blue shorts, is crawling on the floor behind a sofa while clutching a heavy math notebook with a sneaky grin.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition, bright 2D cartoon animation. Mintu, a 9-year-old naughty Indian boy with messy black hair tied in a small ponytail, wheatish skin tone, wearing a bright red T-shirt with a blue star graphic and blue shorts, is crawling stealthily behind a colorful sofa in an Indian living room. He is holding a heavy math notebook, giving a mischievous and sneaky expression. Warm indoor lighting, medium close-up, sharp focus.

scenes.narration: Mintu apna master disguise use kar raha hai!
scenes.dialogue: Main toh ek busy professor hoon! No homework, only science!
scenes.action: Mintu wearing a fake paper moustache and glasses, acting like a serious statue.
scenes.background: Living room corner with a bookshelf filled with colourful books.
scenes.camera: Eye-level, medium shot with a quick zoom-in.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu wearing a comical fake paper moustache taped to his upper lip and oversized paper glasses, striking a dramatic pose like a serious professor next to a bookshelf.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition, bright 2D cartoon animation. Mintu, a 9-year-old naughty boy with messy black hair in a ponytail, wheatish skin tone, wearing a bright red T-shirt and blue shorts, has put on a funny fake paper moustache and oversized paper glasses. He is striking a dramatic, serious professor pose next to a bookshelf in a living room. Humorous expression, vibrant lighting, vertical 9:16 composition.

scenes.narration: Achanak, ye kiska shadow aa gaya door par?
scenes.dialogue: Oh no... Mummy aagayi! Ab kya karein? Fast fast kuch socho!
scenes.action: Mintu sweating profusely as a scary shadow appears on the wall holding a plate of samosas.
scenes.background: Living room wall with a prominent shadow silhouette projected on it.
scenes.camera: Wide shot transitioning to a dramatic close-up on Mintu's sweating face.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu's face filled with pure panic, sweat drops flying off his head, while a threatening shadow of Mummy holding a plate of hot samosas looms large on the yellow living room wall.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition, bright 2D cartoon animation. Mintu, a 9-year-old naughty boy with messy black hair in a ponytail, wheatish skin tone, wearing a red T-shirt and blue shorts, is sweating profusely with a panicked and terrified expression. On the wall behind him, a large shadow silhouette of an Indian mother holding a plate of samosas is visible. Dramatic lighting, vertical 9:16 composition.

scenes.dialogue: Zzz... Mintu is sleeping... dreaming about equations... zzz.
scenes.action: Mintu quickly covers his math book with a comic book and pretends to sleep with open eyes.
scenes.background: Living room floor with the sofa behind him.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu frantically sliding a colourful comic book over his blank math notebook, lying flat on his back on the rug, eyes wide open pretending to snore loudly.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition, bright 2D cartoon animation. Mintu, a 9-year-old naughty boy with messy black hair in a ponytail, wheatish skin tone, wearing a red T-shirt and blue shorts, is lying on a living room rug. He has hastily placed a colorful comic book on top of his blank math notebook and is pretending to sleep with wide-open eyes, making a funny snoring face. Bright indoor lighting, vertical 9:16 composition.

scenes.narration: Mummy ka radar kabhi fail nahi hota!
scenes.dialogue: Wah beta! Math ka homework dream mein kar raha hai kya? Chal uth, pen nikaal!
scenes.action: Mummy walks up, pulls the comic book away with lightning speed. The math book is completely blank.
scenes.background: Living room floor with Mummy standing over Mintu.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at Mummy, dramatic reveal shot.
scenes.visual_description: Mummy, an observant Indian mother with hair in a neat bun, wearing a teal green cotton saree with a yellow border, snatches the comic book away with a swift hand motion to reveal a completely blank math notebook underneath.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition, bright 2D cartoon animation. Mummy, a 35-year-old Indian mother with hair in a neat bun, wheatish skin tone, wearing a teal green cotton saree with a yellow border, stands over Mintu with an annoyed expression. She has just snatched away a comic book, revealing Mintu's completely blank math notebook. Mintu looks up nervously from the floor. Dynamic lighting, vertical 9:16 composition.

scenes.narration: Moral of the story... bhagte raho, par homework peecha nahi chodega!
scenes.dialogue: Bro, ye homework kabhi khatam hi nahi hota! Samosa bhi cold ho gaya!
scenes.action: Mintu sitting at the study table, crying dramatically with a samosa in his mouth while writing.
scenes.background: A messy study table with books, pencils, and a plate containing a cold samosa.
scenes.camera: Static eye-level medium shot focusing on Mintu's funny expression.
scenes.visual_description: Mintu sitting on a chair at a study table, making an exaggerated dramatic crying face with tear streams, a half-eaten cold samosa stuffed in his cheek, desperately writing in his math notebook with a pencil.

ending_lesson: Homework se bhago mat, jaldi khatam karo toh samosa double milega!
